entries.title: Exodus 1:5
segments: Seventy souls; including Jacob himself, Joseph, and his two sons.

entries.title: Exodus 1:6
segments: No excellence of character, and no degree of authority, influence, or usefulness among men can keep off death.  It becomes all, therefore, to prepare for it, by setting their affections on things above, and laying up treasure, not on earth, but in heaven.

entries.title: Exodus 1:8
segments: Knew not Joseph; was ignorant of his eminent services.  Probably he belonged to a new dynasty.

entries.title: Exodus 1:10
segments:
Deal wisely; cunningly, in such a manner as to diminish their number and power. 
 
Tyrants often pretend that their unrighteous decrees are needful to the welfare of the state.  Were this true it would not excuse them, for the end does not justify the means.  But it is not true; the permanent good of individuals or communities is never promoted by doing wrong.

entries.title: Exodus 1:11
segments:
Burdens; exactions of labor and money. 
 
  Treasure-cities; fortified places for the keeping of military or other stores. 
 
  Pithom and Raamses; cities in the north-east part of Egypt, in or near Goshen.
The providences of God often alarm men; and to prevent evils, real or imaginary, and obtain good, they frame and execute wicked devices.

entries.title: Exodus 1:16
segments: See them upon the stools; the Hebrew may be rendered, "ye shall look upon the stones."  The reference is supposed by some to be to a basin of stone, with a stone lid, used to wash the new-born infant.

entries.title: Exodus 1:20
segments: God dealt well with the midwives; blessed them because they would not obey the command of Pharaoh.

entries.title: Exodus 1:21
segments: Made them houses; increased and prospered their families.
